thread.title: Every Dow stock falls premarket, led by Boeing - MarketWatch

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Every Dow stock falls premarket, led by Boeing - MarketWatch
text: All 30 components of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -1.01% are declining in premarket trade Thursday, with Boeing Co. BA, -1.76% shares pacing the losses, as Dow futures YMM8, -1.33% fall 311 points ahead of the open. Boeing's stock was shedding 2.0%; the $6.65 price decline would shave about 46 points off the Dow's price. Among some of the other bigger decliners, shares of Travelers Companies Inc. TRV, -1.05% gave up 1.6%, Chevron Corp. CVX, -1.37% shed 1.5%, Intel Corp. INTC, -0.16% lost 1.4%, Microsoft Corp. MSFT, -1.14% slid 1.3% and American Express Co. AXP, -1.64% fell 1.4%. The most active stock was Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.95% which lost 1.1%.
